about.heading: Hello! I'm Muhammad Fariz.
bioParagraphs: I am a software engineer studying Informatics Engineering at Politeknik IDN Bogor, passionate about building robust web and mobile applications.

My development journey covers a wide spectrum of modern technologies, from crafting mobile interfaces with Flutter and Dart to building scalable web platforms using Vue.js, Nuxt, Next.js, and Laravel.

Beyond writing code, I enjoy optimizing performance, managing backend configurations with Supabase and Node.js, and implementing practical solutions—like local SEO and containerization—to solve real-world problems efficiently.

projects.title: A mobile blogging application utilizing local data storage for a seamless reading and writing experience.
projects.description: Developed a dedicated mobile application built entirely with Flutter and Hive for fast, responsive local data persistence.

projects.title: A real-time digital ecosystem for tracking Qurban activities, featuring public TV monitors and a field PWA.
projects.description: Engineered a robust system for AhsanTV using Supabase. It includes an admin dashboard, a QR-scan-based PWA for field teams to track animal arrivals and slaughtering, and real-time syncing with offline local storage support.

projects.title: A privacy-focused, real-time Islamic Q&A platform operating without personal data collection.
projects.description: Designed and developed solo using Nuxt and Supabase. The platform relies on browser fingerprinting to ensure an anonymous, safe discussion environment while maintaining a clean, responsive UI.

projects.title: A dynamic company profile and donation reporting platform for a religious broadcasting network.
projects.description: Built and deployed on Vercel, this platform features real-time donation reports, live streaming banners, weekly broadcast management via Supabase, and interactive web quizzes.
